notes: The job detail page is the Lighthouse target because it carries the viewed-jobs scripts and a 'More jobs' grid of JobCards without loading the third-party Turnstile script.
The only best-practices deduction is a 404 for /favicon.ico from the local static server; the theme does not ship a favicon.
Default simulated throttling is host-CPU bound on this machine: a bare HTML page scored 85 (TBT 600 ms). 'provided' measures the page without that host noise. CLS was 0 under both.
The jobs listing also measured performance 99 with CLS 0 under the same settings; the difference is the third-party Turnstile form island on that page.
